desc: Read K, S, and T from standard input.
Check if |len(S) - len(T)| > K; if so, print "No" and exit.
Initialize a DP array with size (2*K+2) to represent the band, using two rows (current and previous) to save space.

Iterate i from 0 to len(S), and for each i, iterate j from max(0, i-K) to min(len(T), i+K), computing the edit distance with the standard recurrence: dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][j]+1, dp[i][j-1]+1, dp[i-1][j-1] + (0 if S[i-1]==T[j-1] else 1)).
Clamp values > K to K+1 to avoid unnecessary large numbers and keep computations bounded.
After filling the table, check dp[len(S)][len(T)]; if ≤ K, print "Yes", else "No".
